metadata.name: Ecodesign for C# / .NET
metadata.description: Ecodesign rules for C#/.NET code: sober Entity Framework, async end to end, allocations, bounded caches, logging.

donnees.name: C# — data access (EF Core / ADO.NET)
donnees.description: Keep the work in the database and materialise only what is needed (RGESN Backend, GR491_Backend_2/3).

rules.title: Premature materialisation of an IQueryable
rules.description: A ToList() or AsEnumerable() before the filters pulls the whole table back, then filters in application memory.
rules.recommendation: Filter, project and aggregate on the IQueryable before any materialisation; paginate (Skip/Take, or keyset: Where(x => x.Id > lastId).Take(n)).

rules.title: Read-only query without AsNoTracking or projection
rules.description: Loading tracked entities just to display them costs memory and CPU (the change snapshot) for nothing.
rules.recommendation: AsNoTracking() as a matter of course on read-only queries, and a targeted Select(x => new Dto { ... }) rather than cascading Include.

rules.title: Count() where Any() is enough
rules.description: Count() walks and counts every row when an existence test can stop at the first one.
rules.recommendation: Any() for an existence test; avoid enumerating the same IEnumerable several times (materialise once when reused).

async.name: C# — asynchrony and network
async.description: Do not block a thread, reuse connections (RGESN Backend/Hosting).

rules.title: Blocking wait on a task
rules.description: .Result and .Wait() pin a thread-pool thread: more threads, more memory, and a deadlock risk.
rules.recommendation: async/await end to end for every I/O.

rules.title: HttpClient instantiated per request
rules.description: One HttpClient per call exhausts sockets and repeats the TLS handshake on every request.
rules.recommendation: IHttpClientFactory (connections reused); enable response compression and cache headers (ResponseCache, ETag).

rules.title: Background service that polls
rules.description: A BackgroundService querying a state in a tight loop consumes CPU and database capacity continuously.
rules.recommendation: Event-driven triggering (message, webhook); failing that, widen the interval substantially.

memoire.name: C# — memory and logging
memoire.description: Limit allocations on hot paths and bound the caches (RGESN Algorithms).

rules.title: Unbounded static cache
rules.description: A static Dictionary used as a cache grows without limit until the process restarts.
rules.recommendation: IMemoryCache with SizeLimit/AbsoluteExpiration, or a distributed cache with a TTL.

rules.title: String concatenation in a loop
rules.description: `s += ...` allocates a new string on every iteration: needless GC pressure on hot paths.
rules.recommendation: StringBuilder for repeated concatenation; Span<T>/Memory<T> for heavy parsing; parameterised structured logging (_logger.LogDebug("x={X}", x)).
